item.title: Oprah Winfrey Celebrates 72nd Birthday
item.description: (AURN News) — Today marks the birthday of Oprah Winfrey, born Jan. 29, 1954, who turns 72. From a childhood marked by poverty in rural Mississippi, Winfrey transformed daytime television and American culture. item.title: Federal Agents Search Fulton County Elections Office
item.description: (AURN News) — Federal agents searched the Fulton County Elections Office near Atlanta, increasing scrutiny of Georgia’s largest voting hub. The FBI confirmed a court-authorized operation Wednesday, serving a sealed warrant tied to records from the 2020 presidential election.
